statements.status_notes: Debian fixed this for trixie in libevent 2.1.13-stable-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6493-1), which ships the upstream 2.1.13-stable point release, and the DHI build of that Debian version carries the fix. Upstream commit https://github.com/libevent/libevent/commit/87e8e44fa774e9677b089b1a5114ee68aefa1636 (http: Discard trailers) parses chunked-request trailers into a temporary header list and discards them instead of merging them into the request headers. Checked by inspecting the DHI Debian packages on amd64 and arm64 with their debug symbols. The evhttp_parse_headers_impl_ function that the fix adds is present in the libevent-2.1 and libevent-extra-2.1 shared libraries and in the libevent.a and libevent_extra.a static archives shipped in libevent-dev, and absent from builds without the fix. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-63379 and https://github.com/libevent/libevent/security/advisories/GHSA-2gmv-p5m7-98p6.
